requirement: Phase251 search must exclude 2026-07-17 and 2026-07-20 from parameter selection.
Phase251 starts from existing Phase235 real event bars; no new raw L2 download until a frozen materially new survivor exists.
At least 5 peer groups with 2 or more available symbols must be present.
At least 20 symbols must be eligible for peer/basket construction.
Pair/basket variants must balance long and short notional before cost and risk scoring.
Zerodha-modeled costs, spread and slippage must be applied per leg; pair/basket costs are not single-leg costs.
No survivor may proceed without positive 2.0x modeled-cost net P&L.
Side-flip, random-side, concentration and cost-stress controls remain mandatory.
Any training survivor must use at least 4 dates, 8 symbols and 20 trades before holdout precommit.
Phase250 is a precommit only: no replay execution, paper/live acceptance or deployable profitability claim.
